outlook.statement: The Indian warehousing industry is set to grow at a CAGR of 8%–10% and modern warehousing at 25%–30% over the next 5 years due to various factors including anticipated increase in global demand, growth in organized retail and increasing manufacturing activities, presence of extremely affordable and desirable e-commerce options and growth in international trade.
The demand for Real Estate & Warehousing in India should remain strong in the medium to long term.

The real estate sector in India is slated to grow at 30% over the next decade. The Indian warehousing industry is set to grow at a CAGR of 8%-10% and modern warehousing at 25%-30% over the next 5 years. The Company plans development of transport infrastructure projects such as Logistics Parks, Warehouses, truck terminals, FTWZs etc in a phased manner with lease-based revenue streams. Many projects are at different stages of planning and getting statutory approvals. The Company shall look for strategic partners/investors for developing Logistics Parks & Warehouses once requisite permissions are in place.

risks: Regulatory requirements such as land acquisition, permitted land use, approval from multiple government authorities, development of land and construction, stringent environmental and safety standards increase cost and affect timeliness of projects
Subdued market conditions and increasing input costs
Timely availability of skilled and technical personnel
Credit risk on receivables (though company expects no/minimum risk)
Liquidity risk managed through cash reserves, banking facilities, and cash flow monitoring
